tagline: Providing reliable, high-quality water service to communities across California, New Mexico, Hawaii, and Texas
hero_kpi_rationale: CWT's business model is entirely dependent on regulatory approval of costs and investments through public commissions. The ability to recover regulatory assets (such as water costs, infrastructure, or TCJA) is the primary driver of its financial trajectory, far more than organic growth or technological innovation.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to the company after taxes and expenses.
kpis.description: Net income declined by 33.8% in 2025 to $128.2 million, compared to $190.8 million in 2024, primarily due to the absence of the one-time gain related to the 2021 GRC and higher operating costs.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in 2025 following a 2024 peak linked to tariff adjustments

kpis.name: Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from water sales and related services.
kpis.description: Operating revenue reached $1,000.1 million in 2025, down $36.7 million (-3.5%) from 2024 ($1,036.8 million), primarily due to lower consumption (-$12.7 million), partially offset by tariff increases (+$69.6 million).
kpis.signal: Revenue impacted by tariff regulation and customer consumption

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to water production, operations, and general overhead.
kpis.description: Total operating expenses increased by $18.0 million in 2025, driven by water production costs (+$11.5 million), depreciation expenses (+$12.5 million), and property taxes (+$3.7 million).
kpis.signal: Significant increase in operating costs in 2025

kpis.name: Water Production Costs
kpis.explanation: Costs of purchased water, electricity, and pumping taxes, representing the largest component of operating expenses.
kpis.description: Total water production costs (purchased water + purchased electricity + pumping taxes) increased in 2025. Purchased water rose from $241.2 million to $252.9 million (+$11.7 million or +4.9%), while purchased electricity decreased from $47.7 million to $45.1 million (-$2.6 million or -5.5%).
kpis.signal: Growing pressure on water production costs

kpis.name: Depreciation
kpis.explanation: Multi-year allocation of investment in infrastructure.
kpis.description: Depreciation expenses increased by $12.5 million in 2025, reflecting continued investment in water distribution infrastructure.

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Cost of financing the company's debt.
kpis.description: Net interest expenses increased by $9.1 million in 2025 due to higher borrowing levels, even though interest rates declined.
kpis.signal: Rising interest expenses despite lower rates

kpis.name: TCJA Liability
kpis.explanation: Amount owed related to the 2017 U.S. tax reform, to be recovered through tariffs.
kpis.description: The liability related to the TCJA tax reform amounted to $60.6 million as of December 31, 2025. The company is working with regulators to finalize its recovery through tariffs.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 5.67 billion € in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to the company after taxes and expenses.
kpis.description: Net income declined by 33.8% in 2025 to $128.2 million, compared to $190.8 million in 2024, due to the absence of the one-time gain related to the 2021 GRC.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in 2025 following a 2024 peak

kpis.name: Regulatory Asset Recovery
kpis.explanation: The company's ability to recover its costs through tariffs approved by commissions, illustrated by the 2021 GRC gain.
kpis.description: 2024 net income includes a $64.0 million gain related to the 2021 GRC (or $1.09 per diluted share), reflecting the recovery of operating and investment costs through tariffs. This amount represents the benefit from the retroactive temporary tariff relief effective January 1, 2023.
kpis.signal: 64 million $ gain related to 2021 GRC included in 2024
